assetRegister.title: Asset register
assetRegister.subtitle: Every machine with a code, its details, place and papers · depreciation follows the settings your CA gives
assetRegister.emptyTitle: No machine in the register yet
assetRegister.emptyBody: Add each machine with its code, place, purchase date and cost. Repair requests, checks and depreciation use this register.

dep.title: Depreciation · by the CA's settings
dep.ready: Ready: every setting the run needs is recorded.
dep.missingMethod: The method (straight line or written-down value, Schedule II) is not set. The CA decides it; Admin records depreciation.method on Settings.
dep.missingLife: No useful life for: {{list}}. The CA sets lives; Admin records them on Settings or on the machine.
dep.missingDates: No put-to-use or purchase date for: {{list}}.
dep.missingResidual: No residual value for: {{list}} (needed for written-down value).

disp.title: Disposals
disp.hint: A book entry: cost and depreciation leave the books and the gain or loss is posted. If it was sold, bill the sale through Sales with GST.
disp.account: Money went to (needed when proceeds are above zero)

form.title: Add a machine
form.hint: Use the code pattern UNIT-TYPE-NO. Cost, dates and life come from the bill and the CA; leave a field empty if it is not known yet.
form.name: Name
form.lifeHelp: Only if the CA gives one for this machine; otherwise the setting applies.

docsDlg.title: Papers of {{code}}
docsDlg.hint: Bills, warranties, AMC and calibration papers go to this company's private assets folder.

notes.title: How the register works
notes.code: Repair requests, daily checks, schedules and papers all hang off the machine's code.
notes.dep: Runs once a month after the month ends, by the method, lives and residual value the CA sets. Nothing is assumed when a setting is missing.
notes.sale: Dispose of it here for the books; the sale itself is a tax invoice with GST from Sales.
notes.docs: Kept in the company's private folder; every upload is logged.
